title: The sync gate drops every git scenario when testmap selects all, even for a kbgit.py change
goal: When testmap's selection is all (a push that also touches pyproject.toml, uv.lock, conftest.py, tests.py, testmap.py or an unplaced path), the gate's fast plan still runs the git scenarios of the test files the code paths select (TestCloudInGit for kbgit.py or querylog.py), so the BG-7kug25eh shape cannot pass the gate; ST-kffdjzv7 kept them only for selections short of all. From the SP-5cwekumc review.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import tests; runs=tests.plan(['_tools/kbgit.py','pyproject.toml'], fast=True); print(runs); assert any(m == tests.FULL_M for _, m in runs), 'no run keeps the git scenarios'
